messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] sample.dat file showing error in reopening
parts:
Deepti

We have had another report of this problem. Can you provide more details: what version of Distance were you using? In what location on the hard disk (specifically) did you create/save your project?

I'm wondering if there is something about the location of the project that is causing the problem. Note that the error message specifies that  the .dat folder (rather than the .dst file) is read only.

In the extreme, we might resort to operating system tools to change the read-only status of the folder, described below.

  1. Run the Command Prompt as an administrator and use the attrib command:
  2. Press Win + X and select "Command Prompt (Admin)" or "Windows PowerShell (Admin)."
  3. In the command prompt window, navigate to the  folder using the cd command.
  4. Once inside the folder, run the following command to remove the read-only attribute:
    attrib -r *.* /s
 However, that does not explain how the folder became read-only.
